description: Tell the Sequenzy team whether an account health insight (id from get_account_health) was useful to the user: rating useful or not_useful, with an optional comment on why. Use it when the user says a finding or suggestion helped or missed, in their words; do not rate on their behalf. It records the API key owner's own answer and changes nothing in the workspace (to hide a finding use update_account_health_insight). One answer per person per insight: submitting again replaces the rating and keeps the earlier comment unless comment is passed (null clears it). Works for insights of any status. 404 for an unknown insight. Requires analytics:read.

comment.description: Optional: what made it useful or not, in the user's words. Omit to keep an earlier comment; null clears it.

companyId.description: Company ID. If not provided, uses the currently selected company.

rating.description: Whether the insight helped the user.

name: submit_account_health_feedback

outputSchema.description: Structured content returned by the `submit_account_health_feedback` MCP tool.

feedback.description: The saved answer: rating (useful or not_useful), comment (or null) and updatedAt.

items.description: Fallback array wrapper used only when a tool returns a bare array.

message.description: Human-readable status, confirmation, or next-step message.

value.description: Fallback object wrapper used only when a tool returns a non-object value.

warnings.description: Non-fatal cautions about content, permissions, or follow-up actions.
